order_policy: Each round includes baseline and candidates; fixed-seed candidate rotation with alternating forward/reverse rounds. Never collect all baseline rounds before candidate rounds.
quantiles: nearest-rank ceil(p*N), ascending; P50 and P90
noise: max(1 millisecond, twice baseline median absolute deviation), evaluated separately for wall and total CPU
invalid_round_policy: Keep every planned outcome. Missing/error samples invalidate completion. External interference is recorded; only a whole round may be repeated with its original retained. Tool/input mutation invalidates the candidate binding.
candidate_binding: Hash both prebuilt executables, original inputs/oracles, source/configuration/locks and measurement producer before and after sampling. A and B use the same worker binary. No builds or competing test jobs during the authorized measurement window.
c_scope: Separate av.owned/1 record-field observation over unchanged D3 expressions, using no persistence. Compare only to matching D3 workloads and retain every original scalar check. C never satisfies A/B promotion or four-path conformance.
